name: Easy Enclosure
summary: Design 3D-printable enclosures for electronics with snap-fit lids, PCB standoffs and cable clamps; exports STL and STEP.
description: EasyEnclosure is an open-source 3D modeling tool for designing 3D-printable enclosures. An intuitive interface and a set of user-friendly controls let anyone create custom enclosures for electronic projects, prototypes or DIY gadgets.
